The '''L70 acid projector''' was a weapon produced by the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]] that shot [[Xenoboric acid/Legends|xenoboric acid]], which could burn through most materials. They sold for 1,250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and were banned in most [[Star system/Legends|systems]].<ref name="LoNH" />
